title: Twist Library Prep: PCR Amplification
author: Opentrons
materials: should be moved back to the OT-2 for this protocol. This protocol begins by adding 10µL of the Twist UDI Primers to each well containing samples from [part two](https://develop.protocols.opentrons.com/protocol/21e4d8-pt2), followed by the addition of 25µL of KAPA HiFi HotStart ReadyMix. The user is then prompted to remove plate and incubate the samples on a thermocycler. Following incubation, the user will return the plate to the OT-2 for a fully-automated magbead-based wash process (2 times) that will result in the 20µL of supernatant transferred to labware selected by the user. This completes the three-part Twist NGS Library Prep. The user can then perform QC or downstream applications on the elutes. steps.title: Set up deck
steps.instruction: Arrange the OT‑2 deck according to the provided deck map, placing the final plate from part two in the designated slot and loading tip racks and any other required labware.

steps.title: Calibrate labware
steps.instruction: Calibrate all labware, tip racks, and the pipette using the OT App calibration routine.

steps.title: Add primers
steps.instruction: Dispense 10 µL of Twist UDI Primers into each well that already contains the sample from part two.

steps.title: Add PCR mix
steps.instruction: Dispense 25 µL of KAPA HiFi HotStart ReadyMix into each well containing the primers and sample.

steps.title: Incubate on thermocycler
steps.instruction: Remove the plate from the OT‑2, place it in a thermocycler, and run the required incubation program (as specified by the Twist protocol).

steps.title: Magbead wash
steps.instruction: Return the plate to the OT‑2 and execute the automated magbead‑based wash routine twice; after the washes, transfer the resulting 20 µL of supernatant to the labware selected by the user.

steps.title: Perform QC
steps.instruction: Carry out quality‑control assays or any downstream applications on the eluted DNA as needed.

steps.title: Run protocol
steps.instruction: Download the protocol bundle, upload a custom labware definition if required, upload the protocol into the OT App, and press “Run” to execute the automated steps.
